item.description: Zhang, S., Wang, Y., Lu, Y., Yuan, S., Wang, L., Xu, L., Yi, K., & Jia, X. (2025). Plant STOP1 family: A helmsman in the soil multiple stress adaptation. Plant and Soil. https://doi.org/10.1007/s11104-025-07807-7 Title: Plant STOP1 family: a helmsman in the soil multiple stress adaptation Authors: Shurui Zhang, Yanlin Wang, Yao Lu, Shuai Yuan, Long Wang, Lei Xu, Keke Yi, Xianqing Jia Abstract: Abiotic stresses significantly reduce crop yields worldwide, with common stressors including drought, flooding, hypoxia, nutrient deficiency, as well as proton and heavy metal toxicity.
